title: The Tropopause - pckt
subtitle: The tropopause is the boundary between the troposphere, where we all live, and the rest of the atmosphere above. This blog lives in the same spot: a place to pause between the things I'm building and the bigger open social web they're part of. Expect notes on building with atproto (for work and for fun!), what I'm learning from folks in the community, dispatches from co-hosting a local atproto meetup, and probably some opinions about community and building healthy spaces on the internet.
